auditType: source-indexed cross-guide semantic regression; browser translation not verified
sourceAccess: Assistant web search returned indexed English guide prose; direct Wowhead opens returned JavaScript anti-bot challenge. GitHub-hosted Wowhead 403 is not a translation failure.

independentSourceEvidence.pattern: stage 3 or higher and 6 or more combo points

finding: Official phrase-memory numeric_facts preserves postfix + as part of value; equivalent localized worded >= expressions then fail the exact numeric-fact equality gate even when the threshold semantics match. The comparison grammar also lacked 'or higher'/'or lower'.
fix: Keep numeric_facts API stable, normalize postfix + only in semantic value comparison, classify compact postfix + as locale-neutral >=, recognize + before canonical resource names, and extend English locale-scoped suffix phrases.
validation: Seven synthetic offline regression tests added for cross-locale equivalence, reversals, resource IDs, addition and signed modifiers. GitHub Actions CI result must be checked separately; no browser-local Translator API result claimed.
nextSteps: Confirm CI, audit unrelated guides for novel patterns and manually verify browser output. Do not mark a clean cycle without representative browser checks.
